ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels dominate over 85% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to distal lobe margins and sparse internal mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs at the distal tips. Left lobe tip shows a white patch extending inward from the margins. Right lobe tip shows a smaller localized white region. Sparse, non-contiguous white pixel clusters (mottling) are scattered across the medial regions of both dark lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central U-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe displays continuous fine-scale serration. Left lobe boundary is highly irregular and discontinuous, characterized by three major macro-scale concave excisions, including a deep V-shaped notch located approximately midway between the median notch and the lobe tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral upward-curving sweep. Right lobe exhibits a consistent convex curve. Left lobe sweep is fragmented by structural voids but maintains an overall upward-outward vector.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular white pixel aggregates located at the distal extremities of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent high-contrast linear pixel disruptions on both lobes. Right lobe features a complex network of long, intersecting diagonal scratches. Left lobe shows multiple shorter, unaligned white marks against the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant physical trauma visible on the left trailing edge, manifested as three large, non-uniform jagged notches and excisions.
other_distinctive_markers: The unique combination of the extreme V-shaped secondary notch on the left lobe and the prominent intersecting 'X' shaped scratch pattern on the right lobe.
